description: This file contains a static helper class 'DatabaseUrlParser' providing methods to parse PostgreSQL connection URLs into ADO.NET connection strings, handling URL validation, extraction of components, and support for query parameters.

classes.name: DatabaseUrlParser
classes.description: A static helper class for parsing PostgreSQL URLs into database connection strings.

methods.name: ToAdoLikeConnectionString
methods.description: Converts a PostgreSQL URL into an ADO.NET compatible connection string, validating URL format and extracting parameters.
